title: YELLOW-FEVER VACCINATING CENTRES _x000D_FOR INTERNATIONAL TRAVEL = CENTRES DE VACCINATION CONTRE LA FIÈVRE JAUNE POUR LES VOYAGES INTERNATIONAUX

sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: A bilingual amendment to the 1970 list of yellow fever vaccinating centres, replacing a centre in the Federal Republic of Germany and adding one aboard a passenger ship in the United Kingdom.
